Junior Backend Software Engineer at Stripe
Location: San Francisco, CA / Seattle, WA

Role:
We are looking for university graduates or entry-level software engineers to join our Core Platform team.
You will write backend services, improve database querying efficiency, and build developer productivity tools.

Requirements:
- Degree in Computer Science or related engineering discipline
- Strong programming fundamentals in Python, Go, or Java
- Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and SQL databases
